Standard: Explosive components for the purpose of removing doors, hatches, and canopies to allow for egress do not cause blast or penetrating injury to any personnel both internal and external to the air vehicle. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Analysis will be used to verify that blast injuries are not incurred by personnel near egress exits upon initiation. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Test will be used to verify that blast injuries are not incurred by personnel near egress exits upon initiation.
  (2) Lab test: Test will be used to verify that penetrating injuries are not incurred by personnel near egress exits upon initiation.
